title: Illustration use / Three equal items

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Give parallel ideas equal visual weight so viewers can compare them without searching for the structure.
strategic_value: A shared illustrated three-column format can make Helsinki lists feel approachable and ordered.
demonstration: A heading spans the upper left on green; three food-related figures sit above matching placeholder captions, separated by thin vertical dotted lines; a small logo sits below.
practical_value: Use repeated illustration-and-caption columns when the content consists of three comparable items.

content_islands.name: Heading and signature
content_islands.spec: Place the heading at upper left and framed logo near the lower left edge.

content_islands.name: Three-column comparison
content_islands.spec: Center one food figure and caption in each column, with dotted dividers between.

ingredient.name: Parallel illustrated columns
ingredient.role: Make comparable items easy to scan.
ingredient.application: Repeat the illustration-caption structure with aligned columns and restrained dividers.
ingredient.scope: Observed three-item placeholder example; no prescribed maximum item count is stated.

reference_purposes.Application: The composition assigns equal columns to three illustrated items.
reference_purposes.Expression: Green background and three serving/eating figures give the comparison a shared character.
